evidence.notes: Single-record async insert accepts AccessLevel in local-test DML mode.
Single-record async update accepts AccessLevel in local-test DML mode.
Single-record async delete accepts AccessLevel in local-test DML mode.

source.content: @isTest private class DatabaseAsyncAccessLevelDmlTest { @isTest static void singleRecordAccessLevelAliasesUseLocalDml() { Database.SaveResult inserted = Database.insertAsync(new Account(Name = 'access async'), AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE); System.assert(inserted.isSuccess()); Database.SaveResult updated = Database.updateAsync(new Account(Id = inserted.getId(), Name = 'access async updated'), AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE); System.assert(updated.isSuccess()); Database.DeleteResult deleted = Database.deleteAsync(new Account(Id = inserted.getId()), AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE); System.assert(deleted.isSuccess()); } }
